svg.desc: and: sift 5.22x, sift (positions off) 4.93x, Elasticsearch 2.34x, pg_textsearch 0.03x, rum 1.03x, pgx-bm25 0.04x; or: sift 2.25x, sift (positions off) 2.33x, Elasticsearch 2.40x, pg_textsearch 2.53x, rum 0.02x, pgx-bm25 0.05x; phrase: sift 4.81x, sift (positions off) 1.36x, Elasticsearch 3.44x, pg_textsearch 0.05x, rum 0.04x, pgx-bm25 0.03x; mixed: sift 3.34x, sift (positions off) 2.26x, Elasticsearch 2.82x, pg_textsearch 0.04x, rum 0.02x, pgx-bm25 0.03x; count(*): sift 6.49x, sift (positions off) 1.63x, Elasticsearch 5.69x, pg_textsearch 0.04x, rum 0.05x, pgx-bm25 0.03x; filter: sift 2.92x, sift (positions off) 2.60x, Elasticsearch 2.70x, pg_textsearch 0.05x, rum 0.03x, pgx-bm25 0.03x; join: sift 6.56x, sift (positions off) 4.15x, Elasticsearch 12.10x, pg_textsearch 0.23x, rum 0.11x, pgx-bm25 0.14x
svg.text: queries per second divided by pg_search, higher is better
Error bars: one standard error over the interleaved rounds (rough for 2-3); red: relative error above 10%.
Elasticsearch: a JVM server over HTTP; its join is a term filter on a denormalized region field.
Simple English Wikipedia, 50,000 articles, 8 clients, median of 2-3 rounds; AMD Ryzen 7 9700X, 16 threads (load avg 4-7); Oct 2026.
